newsitem.title: USA: DeVry stock up on ex-dividend buying-analyst.
newsitem.headline: DeVry stock up on ex-dividend buying-analyst.

text.p: Shares of DeVry Inc, which operates private technical and business schools, closed sharply higher on Wednesday, a gain one analyst tied to the issue going ex-dividend tomorrow.
The stock rose 4 to close at 42, still below its 52-week high of 50-3/4.
"The stock is off its high so it was a good buying opportunity before the company goes ex-dividend," Alexander Paris, an analyst at Barrington Research Associates Inc, said.
Last month, the company's board of directors approved a two-for-one stock split through a 100-percent stock dividend payable December 18 to shareholders of record December 2.

Cathy Klepack, a DeVry spokeswoman, said there were no announcements from the company today to account for the stock price increase. She added that recent selling by institutional holders, attributed to what she called "year-end window dressing," affected the stock.
"The low trading volume created an oversold situation and buyers are aggressively stepping in to correct that situation," Klepack said.
"The stock has sold off in recent weeks," confirmed John Larson, an analyst at GS2 Securities Inc.
